peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 1.8% below its local comparables; 70 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (86.4): 5.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 339 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,054,440 ($2,177 psf, 484 sq ft; 6 resales, Aug 2023–Jul 2025); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,210 psf (range $1,840–2,718); 1.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $16,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,959,444 ($2,364 psf, 828 sq ft; 8 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,180 psf (range $1,872–2,468); 8.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $153,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,118,888 ($2,213 psf, 1,291–1,474 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,002 psf (range $1,826–2,141); 10.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $297,000 more. 4-bedroom: median $3,510,000 ($2,038 psf, 1,722 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,708 psf (range $2,276–3,476); 24.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $1,154,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Telok Blangah MRT about 270 m, Labrador Park MRT about 590 m; closer than 529 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest Blangah Rise Primary School about 510 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 240 m), more than 93 of 662 similar developments (the same as 38); nearest hawker centre Telok Blangah Food Centre about 190 m; nearest park Mount Faber Park about 480 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Terra Hill, 98 new sales, about 1,840 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 19 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 98 new sales and 174 resales (272 purchases); new sales were 36% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Telok Blangah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 640 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 174 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 7 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 174 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 227 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−23.3%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
